settings.title: Google Search Console
settings.subtitle: Connect Search Console so RankMeFast can show real index status and rich-result verdicts in your audits.

connect.title: Connect Google Search Console
connect.description: Let RankMeFast read your index status and rich-results verdicts from Search Console. Requires a verified property.
connect.scopeNote: We request read-only access to your Search Console data.

connected.title: Connected
connected.subtitle: Choose which Search Console property RankMeFast reads from.
connected.propertyMissing: No verified properties found — we'll auto-detect a match on the next audit.

needsReconnect.title: Your Google connection needs to be reconnected
needsReconnect.body: Google requires re-consent — this happens if you revoked access or the connection sat unused for months. Your audits still run without it, but index-status data will be missing.

disconnect.confirmBody: This removes this site's Search Console and Analytics selections. Other sites and the shared Google sign-in stay connected.
disconnect.siteUnlinked: Google was unlinked from this site.

revoke.confirmBody: This revokes Google access and unlinks all {{count}} connected sites. This cannot be limited to the current site.

autoMatch.matching: Matching this site to its Google properties…
autoMatch.ambiguous: More than one property matches this site. Choose one below.
autoMatch.no_match: No exact property match was found. Choose one below.
autoMatch.scope_missing: Analytics access has not been granted yet.
autoMatch.unavailable: Automatic matching is temporarily unavailable. You can choose a property below.
autoMatch.not_connected: Connect Google to match this site.

errors.missingScope: That connection is missing the Search Console permission. Try connecting again and keep the checkbox ticked.
errors.notConnected: You haven't connected Google Search Console yet.
errors.invalidProperty: That property is not in your verified Search Console properties. Choose one from the list.
errors.quotaExceeded: Search Console's daily quota is exhausted. Try again tomorrow.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't reach Google Search Console. Try again in a moment.
errors.loadFailed: Could not load your Google connection.
errors.linkFailed: Couldn't connect that Google account. Pick the same account you signed in with, and grant Search Console access.
